notes: New article for 'vitamin B12 deficiency gray hair' (about 4,400 searches a month across variants; no dedicated FullyVital page). Part of hub 4 under /vitamins-for-gray-hair.
FAQ from Google's 'People also ask' questions: how long B12 takes, why gray hair turns dark again, which vitamin is lacking, which form of B12 is best.

3 studies, each linked once in the references: a 52-person case-control study (B12 198 vs 343 pg/ml), a 71-case review (B12 deficiency and hypothyroidism linked to early graying) and a 2015 dermatology review of B12 deficiency signs and treatment side effects.

Honest on the evidence: association, not proof; 'correct a confirmed deficiency, don't megadose'. Product bridge to Anti-Gray Supplements (B12 as methylcobalamin, per the product sheet) and the Kit; blog-to-product links only.
No survey statistic (new page). No reviewer line.
